oh-my-hermes is an operating layer for Hermes Agent . You keep talking to Hermes. OMH picks the skill and a model for each lane, and runs the work in parallel. It never patches or replaces Hermes, and it never reports planned work as done.
The right model for every lane. Each lane is tagged with a work category: ultrabrain , deep , visual-engineering , quick and more. The category picks that lane's model chain and reasoning effort, and you can edit every chain. When a provider rejects a model, the chain moves to the next one instead of silently downgrading. omh model opens the picker; see which model runs each lane .

/dag-ulw graph runs. Your goal becomes a graph of small nodes, and the ready ones run in parallel. Each node runs on its category's model and effort; nodes running at once never share a write scope. A separate node checks the goal, and failed nodes are repaired before the report.

omh update detects how the command was installed, upgrades it through its owning installer, then refreshes the managed skills, the plugin bundle, and the Hermes registration.
Bun and npm also need Node 18+ and Python 3.11+ on PATH; Homebrew brings its own Python. Run omh setup after any of these, same as above.
Manual package-manager fallback or removal:
Use the manager command directly only when omh update reports that its owning manager is unavailable. Removing the command package preserves OMH state. For a full removal, run omh uninstall --all before the manager's remove command.
Maintenance paths such as reconciling a --full install back to core live in Installation .
Ten ulw- workflows. Say the trigger in chat — Hermes routes the rest. Full catalog: Workflow Reference .
Type these at the Hermes prompt. The ulw- prefix picks the workflow; the rest is your request in plain words.
1. Shape it. ulw-interview when the idea is still fuzzy, ulw-plan when the change is known but risky.
2. Build it. ulw-work runs the accepted plan in parallel lanes that never edit the same file.
3. Finish it. ulw-loop keeps cycling until the gate you name passes.
Hermes Agent already runs the loop. OMH decides what goes into it: which model and effort each lane gets, who owns the code change, which skills apply, and what counts as done. Two rules hold everywhere: model choice and coding ownership are separate decisions, and nothing prepared is ever reported as executed. The generated catalog, triggers, and evidence rules live in Workflow Reference .
Understand → Research → Decide → Plan → Execute → Verify → Operate → Learn
OMH never reports that work happened unless it watched it happen. Every status you see has two parts: the stage, and how sure OMH is about it.
An executor saying it is done is not the same as anything having been checked, and most tools spell both "complete". Capability impact is reported across separate dimensions rather than one marketing score; see Capability Impact . The product A/B lane that compares Hermes alone with Hermes through OMH has its corpus and offline pilot in place, and no measured run is published yet: benchmarks/product-ab/v1/README.md .
